title: pplr 2.0 has no bin/pplr, so the pplr liberator fails molt upgrade and resleeve: install pplr from Homebrew, in cldr's shape (hv, 4 Nov)
body:
## What

pplr 2.0 is a Rust binary from Homebrew (`matthewsinclair/pplr/pplr`), and a Pplr checkout no longer has `bin/pplr`. The pplr liberator still found the checkout by `$MOLT_PPLR_HOME/bin/pplr` and linked it into `~/.local/bin`. So on a sleeve that enables it, as Molt-matts' manifests do for rhadamanth and gyges:

- check failed with `pplr: repo not found` and install with `Pplr repo not found at: ~/Devel/prj/Pplr`, so resleeve failed on it;
- the upgrade hook failed for the same want of `bin/pplr`, so `molt upgrade` exited 1;
- a sleeve that still had the old `~/.local/bin/pplr` link held a dead link, or one that ran pplr 1.x ahead of Homebrew's.

Measured on rhadamanth, 4 Nov 2026, with Homebrew's Molt 1.4.0: `pplr_check` printed `pplr: repo not found` and failed, with `~/Devel/prj/Pplr/bin/` holding `devbin` and `Icon`.

hv's ask, 4 Nov 2026, relayed by pplr-vc: the liberator in `liberators/cldr.sh`'s Homebrew shape, with no `~/.local/bin` link and no upgrade hook; install removes the old checkout link, and check reports one; `MOLT_PPLR_HOME` goes if nothing else reads it; then Molt 1.4.1. pplr-vc's ruling the same day carries hv's 27 Oct rule from issue 0071 into it: a dev or opt tree that `pplr use` chose is the user's choice, which check names and never faults.

## Next

pplr-dc, in a fresh clone of main: the liberator and its tests, red on the old liberator, then green; ShellCheck; the suite under bash 5 and `/bin/bash` 3.2, in a slot pplr-vc grants; then one commit on main with this note, unpushed, for pplr-vc to verify.

## As built

pplr-dc, 4 Nov 2026, in a fresh clone of main at 6d8aaae, landed in one commit with this note.

1. `liberators/pplr.sh`: pplr comes from Homebrew. `_pplr_faults` asks `molt_brew_faults` that Homebrew's pplr is what PATH runs, unless PATH runs a pplr whose version line names the dev or opt tree, when it asks `molt_brew_install_faults` only that the formula is installed, as Gtools' switch mode does (issue 0073). Check and verify name what PATH runs. `_pplr_checkout_link` finds Molt's old link, `MOLT_LOCAL_BIN/pplr` to `<root>/bin/pplr` with `<root>/.git`: check names it, and install removes it and no other link. `pplr use` points `~/.local/bin/pplr` at a checkout's `target/release/pplr` or an opt tree's `bin/pplr`, and `pplr use brew` removes the link only when it serves one of pplr's own trees. The old link serves none, dead into a 2.x checkout or into a 1.x one, which has no `Cargo.toml`, so it is Molt's to remove. The header says where the liberator differs from cldr's. `pplr_upgrade`, `pplr_repo` and `pplr_repo_git_commands` are gone.
2. `lib/constants.sh`: `MOLT_PPLR_HOME` is gone. Nothing else read it, in Molt or in Molt-matts.
3. `test/liberators/pplr.bats`: ten tests on the shared brew stub. They cover Homebrew's pplr on PATH; a formula not installed; one not trusted; the old link to a 2.x checkout and to a 1.x one; a dev and an opt tree `pplr use` chose; such a tree with no Homebrew pplr; another pplr ahead of Homebrew's; and no upgrade hook or repo. The formula's name is written in the test, not read from the liberator. `test/git.bats` loses its test of pplr's repo functions.
4. Docs: the README's Homebrew exceptions and liberator table, with `PPLR_HOME` gone from its variables; `MODULES.md`; `writing-a-liberator.md`'s rule 1 and its links into `$MOLT_LOCAL_BIN`; and the CHANGELOG, under Unreleased.

Proof, in slot 01M6JXYPJVWNKJEB4HZ5200V72, which pplr-vc granted. `bin/molt test pplr` with the new tests on the old liberator (5c7aa30, never landed) exited 1, all 10 failing on their assertions with the old liberator's `pplr: repo not found`. At the fix, 8384180, it exited 0 with all 10 passing. The suite at 8384180 exited 0 under bash 5.3.20 and exited 0 with `/bin` first, bash 3.2.57, 650 tests each, ShellCheck clean on 42 scripts. ShellCheck, `bash -n` under both bashes and prettier pass on what changed.

Not done: Molt-matts' manifests enable pplr on rhadamanth and gyges with `os = ["linux", "macos"]`, while the formula is for macOS on Apple silicon only. Both sleeves are Macs, and the manifests are hv's stack config.

## Not this issue

Issue 0071, a source choice of brew or checkout, stays open and deferred: closing it is hv's call.
